transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. I wanted to get us together to discuss the peer climate liaison pilot. As you know, this is an eight-week pilot to give employees a neutral first contact for everyday collaboration concerns. The liaison can receive concerns and connect employees with support, but won't be investigating complaints or making disciplinary decisions. I'm responsible for making the binding appointment and approving the operating arrangements. Before we finalize anything, I need our team lead, employee experience partner, and HR operations specialist to formally disclose any relevant input, and I'll be recording each disclosure in the staffing review. We're considering Priya, Noah, and Tessa for the role. I also want to flag upfront that the appointment record must verify any required qualification before appointment — no one can be appointed provisionally and complete a qualification later. If someone has completed a required course, we can verify that by adding the completion record to the appointment record before finalizing. Let's go through what everyone knows and what input you each have.
